recipe.visualDefinition: A dual-layered composition featuring a group of women in a sepia-toned, water-based environment on top, transitioning into a dark, pixelated mosaic of the same group in theatrical costumes on the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical split between organic sepia photography and dark digital pixelation
Repetition of the human subjects across two distinct stylistic halves
Contrast between the fluid water background and the rigid geometric grid
Textual dominance in the upper corners framing the central subjects
coreInvariants: Checkerboard pixelation pattern in the lower-left quadrant
Sepia-washed color palette for the upper half
High-contrast black background for the lower-right quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged diagonally in the top half; multiple subjects in a tiered formation in the bottom half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the top half leaning forward, creating a strong vertical line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large red text top-right, down the diagonal line of the figures, into the pixelated grid at the bottom-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open water surface in the top half provides breathing room for the title text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and muted tan (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red (primary title) and teal/orange (costume details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark figures and light water.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' features a high crossbar
The 'R' has a straight, diagonal leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, heavy display face paired with a light, airy secondary sans-serif for maximum hierarchy contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, heavy feel of the primary title.
Provides the clean, spaced-out look for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s-style photograph of a female rock band. The top half shows them in a shallow, sepia-toned pool of water. The bottom half shows them in elaborate feathered costumes against a black background. Apply a square pixelation/checkerboard effect to the bottom-left quadrant where the two scenes meet.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, bold red sans-serif title in the top right corner. Place a smaller, light-weight sans-serif subtitle in the top left corner with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the pixelation restricted primarily to the bottom-left?
Is the color palette dominated by sepia and black?
Is the primary title in a bold, red, geometric font?
Does the composition feel split horizontally?

postGenerationChecks: Check for film grain consistency across both halves.
Ensure the pixel grid aligns with the horizontal split.
Verify the red text has a slightly weathered texture.
Confirm the subjects' poses feel candid and rock-inspired.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Sepia Water Photography] + [Dark Theatrical Portrait] + [Geometric Pixel Overlay] + [Bold Red Sans-Serif Typography]
